name: PR brief renders seeded prose, a risk, and a review-focus entry on the Overview tab, and never shows the generating headline
description: AC-1: open the seeded repo's PR #482 (default tab is 'overview' — no tab click needed) and confirm the stored brief (server/src/db/seed.ts's seedBrief, head_sha pinned to the PR's own headSha so it reads non-stale) renders its 'what' prose in the PR brief card, a risk title ('Auth surface touched') in the Risk areas section inside the Intent card, and a review-focus file location ('src/config.ts:12') in the Review focus card. Final assertion is a `get text body` step with `stdoutExcludes` against brief.json's card.generating.headline ('Generating brief') — this proves the card never enters the generating state for a non-stale brief, NOT that no model call occurred: a browser flow cannot observe network calls the server made. The zero-model-call guarantee (AC-1's 'without making a model call') is proved by server/test/brief-routes.it.test.ts against a call-counting stub, not here. Read-only seeded data throughout. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api is the first repo and PR #482 (guaranteed by e2e-web.yml / scripts/e2e.sh).
